# Date Picker

A date picker component built with Calendar and Popover.

## About

The Date Picker is built using a composition of the `<Calendar>` and `<Popover>` components.

## Usage

```tsx
import { format } from "date-fns"
import { CalendarBlankIcon } from "@phosphor-icons/react/ssr";
import { useState } from "react"

import { Button } from "uiofcraft"
import { Calendar } from "uiofcraft"
import {
  Popover,
  PopoverPopup,
  PopoverTrigger,
} from "uiofcraft"
```

```tsx
const [date, setDate] = useState<Date>()

return (
  <Popover>
    <PopoverTrigger
      render={
        <Button
          className="w-[280px] justify-start text-left font-normal"
          variant="outline"
        />
      }
    >
      <CalendarBlankIcon />
      {date ? format(date, "PPP") : <span>Pick a date</span>}
    </PopoverTrigger>
    <PopoverPopup align="start" className="w-auto p-0">
      <Calendar mode="single" selected={date} onSelect={setDate} />
    </PopoverPopup>
  </Popover>
)
```
